name: Challenge: Interrupting a substantial APNG export leaves no partial download and allows a later export
description: Exercise the compiled local PixiBun build through user controls. Use a desktop viewport. Compare actual artwork and persistent state, not only element visibility. Missing prerequisites or unobservable cancellation must be reported rather than silently skipped.

planSteps.description: Verify restoration has finished and the main drawing canvas is editable.
Open File, then Canvas size… and resize to 256 by 256 with Scale Artwork enabled; apply the resize.
Draw a short horizontal stroke in the upper-left quarter of the drawing canvas, away from its borders.
Use Frame actions, Duplicate frame repeatedly to produce 24 frames.
Verify exactly 24 frames exist and the current frame still contains the horizontal stroke.
Open Export drawing and select APNG at 2x scale.
Click Download APNG and press Escape immediately while Encoding APNG progress is active.
Verify the export dialog closes and no APNG download completes for the cancelled operation. If encoding completed before cancellation could happen, report this case blocked rather than passing it.
Verify all 24 frames and the original stroke remain intact.
Open Export drawing and select PNG at 1x scale.
Verify a nonempty PNG downloads and opens as the original 256 by 256 drawing; a filename without a completed file is insufficient.
